system.description:
You are able to enhance your Smoke Style, granting them enhanced effects based on the stance variant.

Punishing Smog.

Attacks made with Cinder Bow gain a +1 bonus to its critical threat range.

You can target a point with an attack you make with Cinder Bow, instead of a creature, when you do, you fill a 10-foot cube, centered on the point with a thick cloud of smoke that heavily obscures the vision of all creatures within the smoke, and creatures outside the cloud cannot see inside the smoke. This cloud lasts until the beginning of your next turn.

Incapacitating Smoke.

The Smoke Chain now has Reach 3, gains the Special property as if it were a Battle Wire.

When you attempt to Trip a creature with your Smoke Chain you can instead choose to attempt to trip all creatures within 5 feet of them comparing your trip result vs each creatures contested result. On a success, they take your [Weapon Damage] + [Weapon Damage]
